title: Design Instagram Photo Sharing
description: Model users, posts, likes, comments, and photo feed.

data.text: Design Instagram. Users upload photos, apply filters, follow others, like/comment on posts, and see a visual feed.

data.title: Post and FeedService
Why engagement-based ranking?
data.text: Instagram feeds are visual. Posts with more likes and comments get more engagement and deserve higher visibility. EngagementScore surfaces viral content.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Post stores image URL, caption, and tags
FeedService ranks by engagement then recency
Tags enable discovery beyond the follow graph
Image storage belongs on S3/Blob, not database
data.takeaway: Instagram is a media feed with engagement ranking. Store images in blob storage, posts in database, and rank by likes and comments.
